entities.summary: Veisjärv is a lake in Estonia. It is located in the village of Veisjärve in Viljandi Parish, Viljandi County, on the border of Mulgi Parish. The Õhne River flows into Veisjärv. Veisjärv is a lake. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
